backend/main.mo: Primary backend canister implementing user profiles, permission checks, and a full task/subtask model with creation, querying, and ID management.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old task structures to the new task model, initializing new fields and rebuilding user task maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping high‑level feature requirements to frontend files, components, and test identifiers.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file across authentication, layout, tasks, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining design tokens, color variables, and light/dark mode theme values.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point loading the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling authentication, profile loading, access control errors, and rendering either onboarding or the task page.
frontend/src/components/Auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button wired to Internet Identity with loading states and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/Auth/ProfileSetu: Modal prompting first‑time users to enter and save their display name with validation and loading states.
frontend/src/components/Auth/SignedOutSc: Displays a sign‑out landing page with feature highlights and a login button using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/Error/AccessDeni: Shows an access‑denied message with a logout button that clears identity and query cache.
frontend/src/components/Layout/Footer.ts: Renders a simple footer with attribution and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Layout/Header.ts: Header with app branding, dark‑mode toggle, user avatar, and login/logout handling via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/Shared/ConfirmDi: Reusable confirmation dialog component supporting loading state and customizable text.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/CommandPal: Command palette modal offering quick actions like creating tasks, searching, and toggling views.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/DueAlertsB: Calculates overdue and upcoming tasks and shows dismissible alert banners based on due dates.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskBulkAc: Provides bulk task operations—complete, archive, delete—with confirmation and loading handling.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskForm.t: Form for creating or editing tasks with validation, date selection, priority, tags, and backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskItem.t: Renders a detailed task row with status toggles, selection, priority and due-date badges, and actions like edit, duplicate, archive, and delete.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskKanban: Displays a task card for Kanban columns with status controls, duplicate, edit, archive, and delete actions plus due-date indicators.
Provides loading skeleton placeholders for Kanban columns and task cards.
Organizes tasks into Kanban columns by status and renders them with scrollable lists.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskList.t: Shows a vertical list of TaskItem components with loading and empty-state handling plus selection support.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskListSk: Renders skeleton placeholders representing list-mode task items.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskPage.t: Main task management page that loads tasks, applies filters and sorting, manages view modes, handles creates/edits, and integrates bulk actions and dashboards.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskToolba: Provides search, sorting, and filter controls for tasks, including status, priority, and due-date filters with clear options.
Provides utilities to filter, sort, and categorize tasks by various criteria and compute due‑date badges/counts.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useCreateTask.t: React Query mutation hook that creates a task through the backend and refreshes the tasks list.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useDeleteTask.t: React Query mutation hook that deletes a task and invalidates the tasks query.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useTasks.ts: Fetches the user’s tasks with polling and depends on actor and identity availability.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useToggleComple: Mutation hook that toggles a task’s completion status and refreshes task data.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useUpdateTask.t: Mutation hook to update full task details and invalidate the tasks list.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useUpdateTaskSt: Mutation hook to update only a task’s status and refresh tasks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, auto‑refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks to get and save the caller’s user profile using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useDarkMode.ts: Tracks and toggles dark mode, syncing the preference with local storage and document classes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identities, and AuthClient initialization.
Adds global keyboard shortcuts for new task, search, and command palette actions.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus custom CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and rendering the app.
frontend/src/utils/normalizeBackendError: Converts backend error values into readable, user‑friendly messages.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from URL or storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS with custom colors, themes, animations, plugins, and container settings for the frontend.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s state, architectural notes, known issues, feature list, and image requirements for the task management app.
